newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products slip, gasoline slides $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products slip, gasoline slides $2.

text.p: European oil products were weaker on Thursday.
Gasoline eased $2 a tonne but activity was thin and confined to Rotterdam barges, traders said.
Naphtha swaps dipped, but physical supply remained very tight due to the week-long closure of Algeria's Skikda port.
Gas oil eased as traders took profits on IPE futures ahead of the October contract expiry, but premiums for heating oil were steady and diesel remained very tight.
Fuel oil was stronger. Barges traded early up $3 at $125-126 fob ARA, before easing back to $122-124.
